title: A fungal hypha
caption: A segment of a fungal hypha: a chitin wall around a eukaryotic cell with a nucleus, mitochondria, ER, Golgi and a vacuole, but no chloroplasts. A septum with a pore divides it from the next segment.
alt: One segment of a fungal hypha with labels for the cell wall, plasma membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, mitochondrion, vacuole, rough endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, ribosomes and a septum.
description: The wall is made mainly of chitin, with glucans, not cellulose.
Inside are a nucleus, mitochondria, rough ER, a Golgi apparatus, ribosomes and a vacuole.
A septum, a cross-wall with a pore, separates this segment from the next.
There are no chloroplasts: fungi feed by absorbing food they digest outside themselves.
